title: Law to help justice-involved youth find jobs or school
summary: This bill would require the Mayor's Office of Criminal Justice to create a program helping young people aged 13 to 24 find education or employment after leaving custody of the Administration for Children's Services or incarceration. The office would try to enroll eligible youth before release, coordinate with the Department of Correction and ACS to track outcomes, and report annually to the Council on the program's enrollment and effectiveness. The law would take effect 180 days after passage.
